en-US.author: Shreyam Adhikari
en-US.description: Quillpane is a small native Markdown notepad and local-file viewer
en-US.longDescription:
Quillpane (formerly Markpad) is a small native Markdown notepad and
local-file viewer built with Go, Wails, and the operating system webview.
Sessions, drafts, and version history stay local, with no account, sync
service, or telemetry.

Features include Markdown editor, split, and preview modes; bounded local
history and recovery drafts; syntax-highlighted source viewing; command
palette and keyboard navigation; local image preview; and external PDF
handoff to the system viewer. Markdown task files provide List, Board, and
Calendar views with workflow columns, tags, due dates, custom colors, highlighted
search, context actions, and recoverable task Trash.
en-US.name: Quillpane
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's new in v0.14.4
- Search filters cards directly in the current List, Board, or Calendar view, with highlighted matches.
- Compact All / Open / Done pills replace the completion dropdown.
- The inline search field replaces the separate results sidebar and keeps the layout steady.
- Existing Markdown files, task edits, recovery and saving behavior are preserved.
- GitHub-only patch by owner request. Microsoft Store, Scoop, WinGet, Snap, website and APT updates are held for a larger release.
- Built with Bun 1.4.2 and Go 1.27.1; no browser engine, Node or Bun bundled.

Install
Linux (one command):
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shreyam1008/markpad/main/install.sh | sh
Or download below:
- markpad — standalone Linux binary
- markpad_*_amd64.deb — Debian/Ubuntu package
- Markpad.AppImage — portable AppImage
Windows: markpad-setup.exe — installer with Start Menu + Desktop shortcuts
macOS: Markpad.dmg — drag to Applications; Markpad-macOS.zip is also provided. The app displays as Quillpane; legacy artifact names remain upgrade-compatible.
